correctness.rationale: For any coalition C, its utilitarian welfare is exactly 2 W(C)/|C|, where W is the sum of internal signed weights. Split off nonpositive/nonconnected components without loss. Every connected coalition of size q≥4 is a path or entire cycle. On a path or even cycle, two alternating matchings of positive edges ensure a matching contribution at least P/2≥W/2≥2W/q. On an odd cycle q≥5, cyclically averaged (q−1)/2-edge matchings guarantee (q−1)P/(2q)≥2W/q. Thus an optimal partition exists with only connected blocks of sizes 1,2,3. The three-tile path recurrence and six 0-containing cycle cases, plus a triangle special case, completely optimize in O(V+E) real arithmetic/comparisons. Unweighted P3 needs size three (welfare 4/3) and K1,3 shows the max-degree-three boundary (3/2>4/3). Independent exhaustive unrestricted partition comparison verified 275 small signed path/cycle instances, not an all-graph proof.
